caption: The drawing depicts a single vessel, likely a vase or decorative jug, outlined in black on a plain, off-white background. The object has a wide, bulbous body that tapers toward the base and expands outward at the top to form two prominent spouts with a narrow neck in the center rising above them. The midsection of the body features a central decorative motif, which consists of a symmetrical floral or leafy arrangement and an ornate frame surrounding a detailed central element. Above this motif are some decorative flourishes and stylized letters. There are two concentric lines near the base, adding additional detail. The entire drawing consists solely of thin, consistent linework without any shading or color fills, and there are no other objects or background details present.
